name: main-wireframe
description: Wireframe display mode — edges + labels only, nodes are invisible. Tests that nodeOpacity=0 hides instanced spheres while keeping edges + labels.

checkpoints.name: main-wireframe
checkpoints.description: A 3D node-and-edge knowledge graph rendered in Qualia, dark theme, viewed in a browser viewport. WIREFRAME: edges and labels dominate; nodes appear only as small point-cloud markers rather than solid bodies. Pure topology - if nodes look like solid shaded spheres, that is wrong.
